_note: New units drawn as variants of an existing unit's art (gen_codex_unit_variants.py). 'from' is the source art folder; 'design' the stated changes (no names or setting terms; prompt_scrub checks). Portrait-only jobs repaint 'portrait_from' as the unit shown by its own installed idle sprite.

sw-unit-sm-slicer.design: a slimmer person with short pale blond hair and a pair of goggles pushed up on the forehead, wearing a dark blue-grey padded vest over a light grey shirt instead of the brown jacket, with a bulky boxy backpack that has a tall thin bent antenna sticking up above the head, holding a small handheld screen that glows bright cyan in the left hand and a small pistol lowered in the right hand

poses.melee-1: drawing a short knife from the belt with the right hand, the glowing handheld screen held low at the side in the left hand
poses.melee-2: a quick slash forward with the short knife, the glowing handheld screen still held low at the side
poses.ranged-1: raising the small pistol in the right hand and aiming it forward, the glowing handheld screen held low at the side in the left hand, not pointed at anything
poses.ranged-2: firing the small pistol forward, with a small bright {flash} muzzle flash at the pistol's tip; the glowing handheld screen stays low at the side and does not fire

sw-unit-wk-suppressor.design: a broad, heavy-set furry person of the same kind with golden-tan fur instead of grey, wearing a padded brown leather shoulder guard on one shoulder and a wide belt of round grey ammunition canisters across the chest instead of the white belt, holding a bulky heavy crossbow-rifle with a large round drum magazine at the hip in both hands

poses.melee-1: lifting the heavy crossbow-rifle to swing its stock
poses.melee-2: a short heavy swing with the crossbow-rifle's stock
poses.ranged-1: bracing the heavy crossbow-rifle at the hip and aiming it forward
poses.ranged-2: firing the heavy crossbow-rifle from the hip, with a small bright {flash} muzzle flash at its tip

sw-unit-wy-field-medic.design: the same kind of tall slender person, wearing a pale cream wrap and a white cloth headband instead of the tan clothing, with a large leather satchel full of bandage rolls and small bottles hung across the body, holding a short spear in one hand and a small bow in the other

poses.melee-2: a quick jab forward with the short spear
poses.ranged-1: drawing the small bow with an arrow nocked, aimed forward
poses.ranged-2: loosing an arrow from the small bow, the arrow just leaving the string, with no flash
